body:
Phase 2, Android. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md.

- List properties: close-vote section (who has agreed, agree / withdraw,
  online-only, disabled offline); leave disabled while open with the reason.
- List screen banners: pending ("2 of 4 agree to close" + agree/withdraw) and
  closed ("Closed on <date>", no add button, read-only).
- Overview: closed marker.
- Form: frozen participants locked (amount shown, not editable, not
  deselectable, excluded from rebalancing); never in defaults.
- SyncEngine: list_closed -> REVERT the local row to the server copy;
  participant_frozen -> quarantine with a message naming who is frozen
  (existing edit-to-clear path). Both distinct from the existing 422 path.
- Strings ×9. Tests for each banner state, the locked form, and both
  rejection reactions.
title: expenses: Android — vote controls, banners, leave rule, rejection handling
